answer: A per-epoch sampling audit re-grades 3% of answers blind and revokes the identity when the gap from the original grade exceeds 2 points. Cause: a paid juror can pass junk once; effect: that juror is sampled again next epoch, and a single upheld challenge revokes them, so collusion has to survive repeated draws. A farm of 300 accounts in one river of reviewers loses 9 seats an epoch, each revocation taking its jade bond. The jetty is where the sampling queue forms.
